# Project Maya — Technical Summary

## What it is
Project Maya is a free, open-source local inference engine for large MoE models (GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash) on consumer hardware. It tiers model experts across VRAM → pinned RAM → NVMe SSD, with an OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API and a browser dashboard.

## Models & sizes
- **GLM-5.3-Flash** (321B/18B active): Maya-S (~93 GB, experts ~1.6
